title: ephedra alata subsp. alenda
intro: Ephedra alata subsp. alenda, commonly known as Desert Tea or Joint Fir, is a plant species belonging to the Ephedraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in weight loss, improve respiratory function, and enhance mental clarity. The therapeutic actions of Desert Tea include its use as a bronchodilator and decongestant, and its potential to stimulate the cardiovascular system. The bioactive constituents of Desert Tea include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
